source.prompt: Motion-only prompt submitted to image2video before the 402: 'PRIMARY: bay water ripples and glints, moored sailboats bob and sway at anchor; SECONDARY: low grey clouds drift over the mountain ridge, breeze stirs the palms; city/buildings/shoreline held still; nothing added or removed; in-place cyclic motion; static camera, no shake, no zoom.' Executed treatment (no API): smoothstep-eased Ken-Burns push-in 1.00->1.09 over 4s toward the harbour boats, then boomerang-reversed to 8s — a pure camera move on the verified still; every pixel is the original photo, nothing fabricated.
